entities.name: Caverns of Ixalan
entities.description: An immense subterranean network beneath Ixalan linking the Core of Paradise to the surface through cave systems, hidden cities and ruins.

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: The plane beneath which the caverns stretch.

entities.name: Core of Paradise
entities.description: An inverted sphere at Ixalan's heart, lit by its own sun, the cradle of the ancient Oltec civilization.

entities.name: Oltec
entities.description: The ancient civilization, ancestors of the Sun Empire, who retreated into the Core to safeguard their knowledge and cosmium and sealed it.

entities.name: Malamet
entities.description: Descendants of the Oltec who carved cities like Ban Koj and rediscovered ancient sites.

entities.name: Deep Goblins
entities.description: Goblins populating the caverns, primarily in the trade city Porobol Koj.

entities.name: Sun Empire
entities.description: The empire descended from the Oltec.

entities.name: Ban Koj
entities.description: The de facto Malamet capital and cultural hub, built into stalactites hanging from a colossal cavern ceiling.

entities.name: Chama Koj
entities.description: A half-sunken ruin where quicksand flows in rapids, the ancient capital of a forgotten culture and a pilgrimage site.

entities.name: Mycoid Maze
entities.description: A fungal forest in a large cavern with bioluminescent spores and tree-sized mushrooms.

entities.name: Porobol Koj
entities.description: A large, mainly Deep Goblin trade city and port beneath Ban Koj.

entities.name: Tecutlan
entities.description: A huge cavern crossed by natural bridges and lit by a lava fall.

entities.name: Topizielo
entities.description: Once one of the greatest cities of the Komon Winaq, now abandoned and covered in luminescent fungus.

entities.name: Komon Winaq
entities.description: The people whose great city was Topizielo.

entities.name: Matzalantli
entities.description: A round corroded copper door covered in glyphs that sealed the Core from the surface.

entities.name: Queen's Bay Company
entities.description: An expedition that breached Matzalantli and reached the Core in 5 Dawn Era.

entities.name: Deeproot Tree
entities.description: A tree whose death shifted balances of power and drew merfolk and others into the caverns.

entities.name: Pashona
entities.description: A merfolk Shaper who rediscovered Matzalantli after the death of the Deeproot Tree.

entities.name: Cosmium
entities.description: A priceless substance found in veins in the caverns and etched into pyramids.

events.summary: The Oltec retreat into the Core to safeguard their knowledge and cosmium.
events.quote: who retreated into the Core to safeguard their knowledge and cosmium

events.summary: The Oltec seal the Core with Matzalantli, cutting off travel between surface and depths.
events.quote: the Oltec sealed the Core using Matzalantli

events.summary: Oltec descendants such as the Malamet carve new cities like Ban Koj and rediscover ancient sites like Chama Koj.
After the death of the Deeproot Tree, Shaper Pashona rediscovers Matzalantli and thousands of merfolk gather in Topizielo to open it.
events.quote: After the death of the Deeproot Tree, Shaper Pashona rediscovered Matzalanti

events.summary: Merfolk bands hold the largest assembly in Ixalan's history to open the door.
events.quote: thousands of merfolk gathered in Topizielo for a convocation to open the door

events.summary: The Queen's Bay Company breaches Matzalantli, reawakening the plane's lost history.
events.quote: expeditions like the Queen's Bay Company braved the deep once more, breaching Matzalantli

events.summary: The death of the Deeproot Tree shifts balances of power, drawing merfolk, mythweavers and adventurers into the caverns.
events.quote: The death of the Deeproot Tree further shifted balances of power
